proposed.source_title: Beware of metacognitive laziness: Effects of generative artificial intelligence on learning motivation, processes, and performance

proposed.reason: Experimental study measured SRL processes and found ChatGPT support triggered metacognitive laziness, undermining self-regulation despite improved task performance.

proposed.source_title: A cross-cultural investigation on perseverance, self-regulated learning, motivation, and achievement
